summary.zh-Hant: 北查科（皮科馬約河與巴拉圭河之間）的歸屬：玻利維亞與巴拉圭都主張，1932 年因此開戰。資料集替兩國畫的範圍在這裡重疊約 33 萬平方公里；本系統不裁判當時誰有理。
summary.en: Ownership of the Chaco Boreal between the Pilcomayo and Paraguay rivers, claimed by both Bolivia and Paraguay (the cause of the war that began in 1932). The dataset extents of the two states overlap here by about 330,000 km².

position.zh-Hant: 主張北查科屬玻利維亞。1910 年前後的兩套地圖集（Shepherd, Historical Atlas（1911）pp. 214–215「South America」；Cambridge Modern History Atlas（1924 年版）Map 135「South America in 1910」，各 B 級）都把北查科畫在玻利維亞境內。範圍取自資料集。
position.en: Claimed the Chaco Boreal. Two atlases of c. 1910 (Shepherd 1911; Cambridge 1924 edition, Map 135; grade B each) draw the northern Chaco inside Bolivia. Extent from the dataset.

position.zh-Hant: 主張北查科屬巴拉圭。這一方的主張目前沒有查到 A／B 出處（上述兩套地圖集畫的巴拉圭主要在巴拉圭河以東），範圍取自資料集，待查證。
position.en: Claimed the Chaco Boreal. No grade A/B source has been found yet for this claim (the two atlases draw Paraguay mainly east of the Paraguay river); extent from the dataset, pending verification.
